status.userObservation: Different configurations may suit different settings. Preserve the tested alternatives for situational research.
status.interpretation: Positive point estimates with intervals crossing zero; no universal or conditional policy is qualified.

source.basis: Committed snapshots plus the explicit research helper; no peer working edits.

arms.stock: Native current tactical splits, final placement and barrels.
arms.single: Prioritize one one-body Healer child, preserve other existing split priorities in remaining slots; protect all own Healers in rear legal cells.
arms.half: Same but one half-size Healer child.
arms.two-singles: Same but two one-body Healer children; other source splits yield the consumed slots.

design.population: Outcome-blind uniform-mixed prescribed armies containing Healer and exactly one named anchor. Existing funded setup supports at least eight stacks. One board in each anchor/map/own-doctrine cell. Both armies exclude Satyr. Opponent, artifacts, augments, synergies, combat and seed fixed.
design.scope: Existing slot allocation only; no extra paid Placement or changed synergy. Paid augment choices already in these sampled armies are held equal across arms. All use ordinary A19 combat.
design.primary: half minus stock paired draw-aware board score
design.requiredControl: half minus single (matched protected placement treatment, same funded budget)

bootstrap.unit: whole independent board, averaging both physical seats
bootstrap.strata: four named anchor cohorts, nine boards per cohort

design.pilotGate: For half or two-singles: at least +1pp vs stock and positive familywise-adjusted lower bounds vs stock and protected single; nonnegative means for all own doctrines; zero rejects, exact native application and opponent invariance. Pilot only; any promotion requires new preregistered confirmation. Single arm diagnostic only.
limitations: Prescribed armies; not full ranked draft or overall ladder win rate.
Conditional on at least eight funded stack slots and exactly one requested anchor.
Only one board per anchor/map/doctrine cell; subgroup estimates exploratory.
Split priority may displace other utility stacks; report those trades explicitly.
New native split counts unsupported by the learned six-creature formation selector retain its native fallback.
Repeated futures absent; uncertainty based on all 36 boards, never per-fight IID.

situationalResearchInputs: Own post-split spell power and casualty margin.
Number of useful unbuffed allies and their upcoming activations.
Repairable front-body HP, incoming damage and regeneration timing.
Legal support positions, reachable allies and visible threats.
Funded stack capacity and the utility child displaced by each split.
continuationRules: Keep the tested helper bytes unchanged; use a separate implementation for any new selector or treatment.
Use these boards for discovery only; exclude all listed setup/combat channels from independent qualification.
Use only information exposed by the serving observation, including doctrine visibility limits.
Keep stock setup and matched protected-single controls; isolate placement and split priority before attributing gains.
Do not derive hard-coded unit, map or doctrine rules from these small exploratory subgroups.
A new situational selector needs training/validation family separation, a frozen policy, exact serving-choice parity and a fresh fixed confirmation.
Budgeted Placement upgrades require their own fully funded comparison.
The user commit request preserves research; it does not rewrite failed gates or activate a default.
